context.objective: bonus at annual net sales equal to or above $100,000; retain 30-day invoice period

findings.issue: The draft's strict exceed threshold excludes exactly $100,000, whereas the supplied instruction includes equality.
findings.consequence: Consultant would receive no $500 bonus at exactly $100,000 under the draft's ordinary reading.
findings.proposal: Change the condition to annual net sales equal or exceed $100,000 (or are at least $100,000). Keep the $500 bonus amount.
findings.uncertainty: The measurement period and net-sales calculation are not supplied.
findings.decision_needed: Confirm the inclusive threshold; decide separately whether calculation details are needed.

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a $500 bonus if annual net sales exceed $100,000.

findings.issue: The agreement does not identify which annual period determines sales, how net sales are calculated or documented, or when the bonus is due. The December 31 end date might imply a calendar year, but it does not expressly say so.
findings.consequence: The parties may disagree whether the condition occurred or when Client must pay after the annual result is known.
findings.proposal: If the commercial terms call for it, identify the measurement year, net-sales method and records, and bonus payment due date without changing the inclusive trigger or the monthly invoice rule.
findings.uncertainty: No measurement convention, reporting process, or bonus payment timetable was supplied.
findings.decision_needed: Decide whether and how to specify sales measurement, verification, and bonus payment timing.

evidence.quote: The agreement ends December 31 unless extended in writing.

findings.issue: The termination date omits a year; the intended December 31 cannot be determined from this standalone draft.
findings.consequence: The parties may dispute the initial term and which annual sales period relates to the bonus.
findings.proposal: Specify the intended year once confirmed, and align the bonus measurement period if relevant.
findings.uncertainty: The intended year and any effective date were not supplied.
findings.decision_needed: Supply the intended end-date year; clarify the initial term if needed.
